entries.subject: DAMIT 266: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 266, version 2009-06-15, pole (60°, 76°), period 3.3581 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 267 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 8.203 ± 0.152 km, NEOWISE best-fit effective spherical diameter, transferred approximately to mesh volume diameter. The NEOWISE v2 table holds one row for 1270, fit code DVBI (diameter, visible albedo, beaming and infrared albedo fitted). A thermal sphere diameter is an approximate mesh-volume scale.
